findings.detail: U64Decimal ends in $. With local pattern search semantics, final LF in 1\n is accepted by both complete request field schemas. Writer validator rejects it only through extra special-case re.fullmatch before following the ref. Thus writer checks do not establish schema itself rejects malformed token. Full Draft validator remains NOT RUN; local Python search is a limited regex witness, not a full ECMA/Draft conformance test.
findings.correction: Use a token pattern that cannot terminate before a final line terminator, or an additional closed character-set constraint, and remove checker-only acceptance restrictions. Add LF/CR/CRLF and magnitude boundary witnesses through both full roots with a validator that consumes schema constraints.

findings.detail: issuer_record records five identity fields and proof_id, but not retained immutable revision/semantic/raw/target/pin/version capture. Changing capture.semantic and ack.semantic together with original issuer proof unchanged still yields Saved/ACK1. Likewise capture.raw/file.raw/root.formal_raw can all change under same original issuer proof and yield Saved. This does not prove an actual product defect; immutable server capture could prevent these substitutions, but that boundary is absent from executable document model.
findings.correction: Represent retained issuer-owned capture record including revision, semantic/raw bytes hash, target identity, expected prior digest, pin/version set and operation binding; compare supplied capture to retained record before receipt/ACK. Concrete negative witnesses must fail without changing original issuer record.

findings.detail: No asset version-set binding exists in capture/root model. A new probe supplying disjoint capture/root asset_versions remains Saved/ACK1 because both fields are ignored. This is an unmodeled proof input, not a claim the current DTO requires that exact key name.
findings.correction: Specify exact M05 root receipt/reference-set projection and how issuer verifies it against captured formal content and pin. Add wrong/missing/reordered/duplicate-version proof witnesses with explicit canonical-set policy.
